proof_scope: fault-injected deterministic step-boundary validation only; not live dream quality or human perception proof

claims.proves: corrupt input cannot execute, corrupt output is blocked with pydantic_errors[] and triage_errors[], prose-only BLOCKED receipts are rejected, and valid schema envelopes pass with no triage errors
claims.does_not_prove: full pipeline readiness, semantic dream quality, Chatterbox perceptual quality, or human-audible acceptance

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: Every Persona Dream DAG step failure carries Pydantic error data plus triage-error {code,cause,next_command} classification and the immutable goal records the Brave Search -> Ask gpt/fable -> Ask WebGPT self-heal ladder instead of prose-only BLOCKED output.

cases.name: goal-records-self-heal-ladder
argv:
python3 - <<'PY2'
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('../GOAL.md').read_text()
required=['Goal-helper closure contract','Primary proof:','human idea lineage','dynamic conversation transcript','Chatterbox render receipts','human-audible','project-agent emotional variation/quality evaluation','Forbidden drift:','Retry/stop rule:','Executable step boundary and self-heal ladder','brave-search','gpt/fable','webgpt','Pipeline step failures are expected states','Pydantic error data first','triage-error code/cause/next']
missing=[x for x in required if x not in s]
print('missing', missing)
raise SystemExit(1 if missing else 0)
PY2

cases.name: pydantic-input-gate-does-not-execute-step
argv: T=$(mktemp -d); echo '{"not_schema":1}' > "$T/input.json"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/dag_step.py --node-id no-execute --command help --receipt "$T/receipt.json" --run-dir "$T" --consumes input.json --produces '' >/dev/null; ec=$?; python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('$T/receipt.json')); print('dag_exit', $ec); print('command_exit', r['commands_run'][0]['exit_code']); print('triage', r['triage_errors'][0]['code'])"; exit $((ec==1 ? 0 : 1))
